` tags above the "Recent orders" heading in `site/orders.html`. They left an oversized gap between the stat cards and the table, on top of the spacing the section already has. I removed them. I didn't re-screenshot the page after the edit. The table, status pills, stat cards and order dialog all looked normal in the screenshot I took before the fix. All 16 functional tests pass.
